text: A patient portal for a physiotherapy clinic: patients book appointments, upload referral letters and follow their exercise plan; physios manage their schedule and write session notes after each visit. It must be HIPAA compliant with a full audit trail, talk to our existing practice-management system over its REST API, and work well on phones. Two physios and a receptionist use it every day. It has to be live before the new clinic opens in April.
notes: HIPAA with an audit trail is a named compliance requirement (P-06 PRESENT). The practice-management system is the technical constraint; as an integration it is a category with no product name, hence P-05 PARTIAL_DEEP.
